TELEGRAM INTEGRATION
info:
This Node-RED flow enables bidirectional communication between the Smart AirGuard ESP32 and Telegram.

Two Main Pipelines:

1. Command Pipeline (User → ESP32)
- Polls Telegram every 2 seconds for user commands (`/status`, `/fan_on`, etc.)
- Sends commands to ESP32 via MQTT feed `telegram_commands`
- Sends immediate "✅ Command received" confirmation to user

2. Response Pipeline (ESP32 → User)
- Listens to ESP32 responses on MQTT feed `telegram_response`
- Forwards responses back to the Telegram user

Supported Commands:
`/status` – System status  
`/sensors` – Sensor data  
`/alerts` – Active alerts  
`/fan_on`, `/fan_off`, `/fan_auto` – Fan control  
`/help` – Help message

format:
Model Validation Metrics

📊 MAE (Mean Absolute Error)

Average prediction error in ppm.
Lower values mean better prediction accuracy.

  • Good: below 50 ppm
  • High: above 100 ppm

📈 RMSE (Root Mean Square Error)

Measures prediction stability and penalizes large errors.

  • Good: below 75 ppm
  • Large spikes increase RMSE quickly

🎯 MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error)

Prediction error in percentage.

  • Good: below 15%
  • High percentages indicate unstable predictions

🏆 Accuracy

Estimated overall prediction quality.

  • Excellent: above 80%
  • Low accuracy means predictions differ from actual gas values

Prediction Error Distribution

Shows recent prediction errors over time.

  • Lower line = more stable predictions
  • Large spikes = sudden gas changes or unstable sensor behavior

ℹNotes

  • Metrics update automatically from live gas sensor data
  • Stable gas values are periodically validated
  • All gas values are measured in ppm

name: MODEL VALIDATION
info:
This nodes shows the following:

### 📊 MAE (Mean Absolute Error)

Average prediction error in ppm.
Lower values mean better prediction accuracy.

* ✅ Good: below 50 ppm
* ⚠️ High: above 100 ppm

---

### 📈 RMSE (Root Mean Square Error)

Measures prediction stability and penalizes large errors.

* ✅ Good: below 75 ppm
* ⚠️ Large spikes increase RMSE quickly

---

### 🎯 MAPE (Mean Absolute Percentage Error)

Prediction error in percentage.

* ✅ Good: below 15%
* ⚠️ High percentages indicate unstable predictions

---

### 🏆 Accuracy

Estimated overall prediction quality.

* ✅ Excellent: above 80%
* ⚠️ Low accuracy means predictions differ from actual gas values

---

### 📉 Prediction Error Distribution

Shows recent prediction errors over time.

* Lower line = more stable predictions
* Large spikes = sudden gas level changes or unstable sensor behavior

---

### ℹ️ Notes

* Metrics update automatically from live gas sensor data
* Stable gas values are periodically validated to maintain continuous model evaluation
* All gas values are measured in ppm (parts per million)
